svg.text: Northbay Regional Water Authority · corporate network
fake IT sender · link to fake Zoom update
NAT · inter-VLAN routing · default-deny between departments
Wazuh agents on every host → :1514 events · :1515 enroll
iptables drops all traffic to the LAN
Analyzer outbound: mail pickup, hash lookups, AI report
Attacker emails an Operations user a fake Zoom update
Analyzer pulls the email, holds it, scores it, fetches the file
File detonated in the offline sandbox
Verdict, quarantine and ATT&CK events land in Wazuh
SOC watches it on the Grafana dashboard
